title: Recessed Electric Wall-Mount Heater, Recessed or Surface, 4000/3000 W, 208/240V AC, White
description:
The QMARK CWH3404F is a recessed or surface-mount electric wall heater with fan-forced operation for heating rooms such as offices, lobbies, hallways, vestibules, basements, conference rooms, and similar spaces. It operates on 208/240V AC, 1-phase power and provides 3000/4000W output with a heating capacity of 6,824/13,649 BtuH. The unit includes a white powder-coated steel grille and steel housing, a unit-mounted integral double-pole thermostat with a mechanical selector dial, and fan-only operation for air circulation during warmer months.

Key Features:

  • Fan-forced heating: Delivers 100 cfm airflow with a 105Â°F air temperature rise.
  • Dual wattage operation: Field convertible 3000/4000W for 208/240V AC applications.
  • Built-in thermostat: Unit-mounted double-pole thermostat for temperature adjustment.
  • Fan-only mode: Operates without heat for seasonal air movement.
  • Automatic fan delay: Reduces cold air at startup and releases residual heat during shutdown.
  • Overheat protection: Manual reset thermal cutout disconnects power if airflow is blocked.
  • Disconnect switch: Built-in power on/off switch for maintenance shutoff.
  • Steel construction: Powder-coated steel grille and steel housing.
  • Mounting options: Designed for recessed or surface mounting in a horizontal position.
  • Rough-in dimensions: 18-1/4 in H x 14-5/16 in W x 3-7/8 in D.

title: SDS-PLUS 2CT 3/16" X 4" X 6"
description: Milwaukee M/2 2-Cutter SDS-Plus Rotary Hammer Drill bits are the Most Durable 2-Cutter bits with up to 20% more holes per charge in cordless rotary hammers. The enhanced rebar guards provide increased durability in hard aggregate and rebar. Breaker Point pulverize the material more effectively resulting in faster drilling speeds. The variable flute allows for maximum debris extraction leading to up 20% more holes per charge in cordless rotary hammer while making it a very durable bit in corded and cordless rotary hammers. Additionally, M/2 features a centering tip for exact spot drilling, wear mark indicator indicating when the bit no longer meets ANSI diameter requirements, and a reinforced flute for durability and minimized vibration. The increased life and efficiency of the M/2 2-Cutter drill bit line provides the ideal solution in general concrete for cordless and corded rotary hammer users.
